issues.summary: Owner CLI cannot rewrite stale temporary evidence entries
issues.impact: SOURCE_OWNERS is CLI-only, but six owner evidence entries contain paths into an ignored temporary artifact directory that must be cleared; current commands can only append evidence, so cleanup would otherwise require a forbidden hand edit.
issues.next_action: Delegate to recoil_tool_maintainer; add CLI/library tests, validate agent-surface registration, then let the parent run dry-run and apply mutations followed by owner audit --strict.

history.note: Issue recorded for future agent tooling/process repair.

Added governed owner replace-evidence with strict unique-match and one-occurrence validation, whole-item replacement, empty/unchanged rejection, field preservation, SHA-256 supersession audit evidence without stale text, dry-run support, and saved/hash reporting. Added focused owner CLI and command registry tests plus the tools README command-index row. Parent reran both focused test suites, agent-surface audit, and issue audit successfully, then applied six governed owner evidence replacements and confirmed owner audit has zero findings.

issues.requested_change: Add owner replace-evidence OWNER_ID --match TEXT --replacement TEXT --evidence TEXT --dry-run. Require exactly one matching evidence item and one occurrence, replace the whole matched item, preserve every non-evidence owner field, and append an audit entry containing the caller rationale and SHA-256 of the superseded evidence text.
issues.benefit: Allows governed replacement of ephemeral paths with inlined durable facts while retaining an auditable evidence history.
